config.name: apiKey
config.description: Your Apify API token for authenticated access. Get it from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Required for data retrieval; optional for server discovery and capability listing.

tools.name: get_stock_data
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive stock market data for individual ticker symbols from Yahoo Finance. Returns current price, intraday high/low, 52-week range, trading volume, market capitalization, P/E ratio, earnings per share, dividend yield, and sector classification. Use for fundamental analysis, stock screening, or building financial dashboards.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol in uppercase format (e.g. 'AAPL' for Apple, 'MSFT' for Microsoft, 'GOOGL' for Alphabet)

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.description: Filter and screen stocks based on financial criteria like market cap range, sector, P/E ratio thresholds, dividend yield, or revenue growth. Returns matching ticker symbols with key metrics. Use for value investing, growth stock identification, or portfolio rebalancing analysis.

tools.name: get_crypto_prices
tools.description: Fetch real-time cryptocurrency prices and 24-hour market data for multiple coins. Returns current price in USD, 24h price change percentage, market cap, and trading volume. Use for crypto portfolio tracking, price alerts, or comparing digital assets.

params.name: coins
params.description: List of cryptocurrency symbols or names to fetch price data

tools.name: get_exchange_rates
tools.description: Look up current foreign exchange rates between major world currencies. Returns exchange rate, bid/ask spread, and last update timestamp. Use for travel planning, international business transactions, or forex trading decisions.

params.name: base
params.description: Base currency code for rate calculation (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY')

tools.name: track_crypto_portfolio
tools.description: Monitor real-time prices and performance metrics for a portfolio of cryptocurrency holdings. Returns current price per coin, 24-hour percentage change, portfolio value summary, and top movers. Use for active portfolio management and price monitoring.

params.name: coins
params.description: List of cryptocurrency codes in portfolio to track real-time

prompts.name: portfolio_check
prompts.description: Get a comprehensive portfolio summary with current prices, daily changes, and market overview for a list of holdings.

prompts.name: market_overview
prompts.description: Generate a broad market overview including major stock indices, crypto trends, and currency movements.

resources.name: Supported Asset Types
resources.description: Available data: stocks (Yahoo Finance), cryptocurrencies, and foreign exchange rates.
